authority: Acceptance checklist, not executed backend integration results. All cases remain pending parent-owned runtime tests.

cases.check: Attach entire pinned references/fsod gitlink, preserve every tracked source/data/map/SQL/dependency file; compile and boot original C# services without GDScript substitutions.

Round-trip every concrete packet from protocol-catalog.json in its authoritative direction, TCP framing/coalescing/fragmentation and continuous directional RC4, signed fields, optional SHOOT suffix, all string widths and rejection/disconnect paths.

Exercise every HTTP IRequestHandler in source inventory with isolated accounts: success, invalid auth, duplicate names/email, guest/recovery/verification, account locks, gifts and purchases; preserve all original endpoints.
Handshake matching 27.3.2; create every XML player class/owned skin, enforce live slot limit, reload same inventory/stats, reject dead/missing chars, wrong build/world/key and duplicate account use.
Enter Nexus, select realm, reconnect/key/new seed, return with ESCAPE and save/reload character; already-in-Nexus response, full world, unusable/missing portals and last-world routing match server.

Update ACKs, tick/time and movement records, ping replies, teleport ACK wire parity, paralysis and ground-tile effects match active original handlers; keep source TODO/commented-out validation distinct from enforced behavior.

Enumerate every world class, maps and DungeonGen template from pinned inventory, enter via actual portal, complete/extract/reload with portal-key/instance/fullness behavior; all dungeon families, not four samples only.

Enumerate every behavior database, state, transition, boss and minion phase from inventory; original AI timers, projectiles, summons/portals and death behaviors run on C#, Godot renders updates/effects.
Weapon-slot validation, projectile IDs/ownership, hit ACKs, defense floor, condition effects, invulnerability and attack modifiers match original server; no local fabricated kills/damage.

Kill-generated public/private bags, damage participation, ownership, distance and valid class-slot swap; soulbound drops/gifts/stacking, capacity, equip boost and reject paths; re-login verifies saved equipment without duplicated items.

Health/mana quick slots 254/255, stack limits and exact XML effect/cost/consumption; normal consumables, successor items, class abilities, cooldowns and fame counters are server-owned; insufficient/invalid-item behavior and saves preserved.

Replay golden XP/level/fame fixtures on C# with each class, randomized inclusive gains/caps/refill, damage-weighted kill XP floor/caps, quest XP, nearby sharing, boosts, one-level event timing, death bonus floor order and integer bank. Stat39 account bank differs from stat57 character base fame.

Original grave/death effects, dead flag, fame record/bank/class best and SQL persistence; reject resurrecting dead char, preserve survivors on disconnect/reconnect/restart, no double deposit across repeated messages.
Two accounts exchange legal items, changed offers invalidate acceptance, cancel/disconnect/distance/full-inventory/soulbound checks; both DB saves persist exactly once with no duplication/loss.
Guild creation costs/ranks, invitations/join/removal/promotion and hall routing, board/member API; chat/whisper/commands/ignore/lock lists and permission checks persist server-side.
Original vault ownership, gifts/chests, gold/fame/token prices and balances, purchases/redemption/unlocks; test with isolated fake account/database data only, no real payment/provider writes.
Hatch/equip/feed/release/evolve/fuse/yard upgrades, rarity/level caps and every pet AI behavior remain C#-owned; currency/inventory and pet records survive reload.
Arena waves/death/exit/records, daily quest item redemption/reward sequence and persistence, owned skin changes and authorization match original features.
Retain SQL schema/migrations, original config/dependency/startup surfaces, rank-gated admin operations, logs and service error/recovery semantics; non-admin cannot dispatch privileged commands.

Godot displays server assets/state and sends inputs only. No local substitute AI, XP, fame, loot, commerce/trades, guild/account/pet ownership or persistence; compare original client/server and Godot replay results for every interface catalog entry.
